svg.title: Eratex BPMN-type order lifecycle and four-zone operating model
svg.desc: BPMN-style business process diagram showing the Eratex order lifecycle from customer inquiry to dispatch across Future/Free, Volatile, Firm, and Frozen/Execution zones.
svg.text: Eratex BPMN Order Lifecycle Across Four Operating Zones
Customer inquiry to dispatch with process lanes, BPMN events, gateways, approvals, WIP movement, wash/rework loops, and zone governance
Zone model shown here: Future/Free, Volatile, Firm, Frozen/Execution. Current code has a narrower three-zone work-item model; this diagram shows the target order-level business process model.

g.text: Quote confidence, scenario load, tentative reservation, sample trigger
Confirm demand, keep controlled flexibility, mature readiness
Lock dates, release production, govern plan changes by approval
Protect near-term execution; absorb delays through recovery, not replanning
QC gates, packing, FG, shipment close

svg.text: Business controls carried across every BPMN lane

g.text: what can move, what needs approval, and what must be locked.
PCD release, frozen/firm changes, line realignment, rewash,
QC waiver and short-shipment approval are business-readable.
Committed qty, cut qty, issued-to-sewing, net-good output,
sewn waiting wash, packed, shipment-ready, dispatched.
BRYG priority, buffer penetration, capacity load, laundry bottleneck,
exception owner, recovery action, shipment risk and OTIF learning.

svg.text: Prepared as editable SVG and 4K PNG. Source basis: Eratex deck zone model, planning-zone research, current EOS-05 build, BRD/order lifecycle, WIP, wash, QC, shipment and dispatch specifications.
